description: This file is a CMake module script (FindSystemd.cmake) used to locate and configure the systemd library, including finding required directories and libraries, and setting up appropriate target properties.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates a package configuration file or generates a configuration for a specified package.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for package configuration modules like pkg-config.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds a library and sets a variable to its location.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds a directory path containing a specific header or file.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard package finding logic, including error reporting.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced, hiding them from normal user cache views.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates a new library target in CMake.

methods.name: set_target_properties
